title: Preserve session capabilities and configure Delta planning
brief: Use a Delta-configured session for Delta operations. A concrete SessionState and an arbitrary Session trait wrapper follow different resolution paths; choose fallback policy when caller configuration matters.

choices.choose_when: You want the supplied Delta planner and defaults
choices.tradeoff: Add caller functions/runtime settings to this state

choices.choose_when: Your existing state includes required Delta planning support
choices.tradeoff: Preserves the supplied state, including any incompatible planner

choices.choose_when: A Session wrapper must contribute runtime/configuration/function registries
choices.tradeoff: Derived state is a documented subset; arbitrary custom planner/catalog behavior is not fully cloned

choices.choose_when: Silently replacing a trait wrapper would violate caller requirements
choices.tradeoff: Rejects wrappers; make the desired concrete state explicit

claims.statement: InternalDefaults is the default fallback for a non-SessionState wrapper. A caller UDF can disappear; DeriveFromTrait preserves the tested UDF while RequireSessionState rejects the wrapper.
A plain SessionContext state passed to the logical-plan write probe fails to plan MetricObserver. The same plan with create_session().state() writes successfully.

create_session_state_with_spill_config(None,None) uses the default runtime. The named max_spill_size configures the FairSpillPool memory budget, while max_temp_directory_size bounds temporary disk; these are separate resources.

A configured 1024-byte FairSpillPool accepted a 512-byte reservation, rejected another 1024 bytes and released the reservation on drop. This tests pool configuration, not total operation/process RSS or automatic spilling.

implementation: Choose policy based on required caller capabilities, then test with a distinguishing UDF/configuration rather than state type alone.
Do not reuse an arbitrary session solely to avoid construction cost; verify planner, store mappings and runtime sharing semantics.
Record runtime limits separately from batch/target-file-size options.
errors: Resolution rejection and missing functions/planner failures occur before a successful commit; verify table state when diagnosing a failed operation.
unknowns: The probes establish UDF preservation, not equivalence of every Session implementation or process memory bounds.

evidence.scope: Exact git-capture full contracts for the selected operations
